evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Welcome to Miami Mayhem!

 When five of the city’s most notorious misfits—Ghosting Gordo, Roxie Rizz, Vinny the Vice, Lola la Reina, and Diego el Fuego—team up for the score of a lifetime, the heat isn’t just coming from the sun. With dirty money, crooked cops, and rival crews on every corner, they’ll have to outsmart the system and outrun the streets. In a city where loyalty fades faster than a tan, trust is a luxury… and survival is the real jackpot!
